name: awesome-claude-mods
description: Small, token-free mods that reshape the Claude Code terminal.

plugins.name: step-tracker
plugins.description: A framed band above the prompt that shows Claude's plan steps, what it is doing right now, the calls it just made, a live activity graph, background agents and shells, and the branch you are on.

plugins.name: android-logcat
plugins.description: A pane that follows the connected Android device's logcat for the app of the current repo, colored by level like Android Studio, with a level floor and a text filter; /logcat turns it on and off.

plugins.name: android-device
plugins.description: A pane that shows the connected Android device and the repo's app on it, installs an APK dropped on the terminal or picked from the build folder (asking before any retry flag), and launches, stops, uninstalls, screenshots or records the app; /adb turns it on and off.
